columns.columnDescription: Unique Identifier
The ID of the office this appointment belongs to.
The ID of the customer this appointment belongs to.

The ID of the subscription if this appointment belongs to a subscription. If an appointment is attached to a subscription it inherits its pricing as well as other defaults. It also resets the next due date upon completion. Stand alone services or reservices will be a -1.
RegionID of the subscription if this appointment belongs to a one. For stand alone services or reservices it will be -1.
The ID of the route that this appointment is assigned to.
The ID of the spot that this appointment is assigned to. Null indicates an appointment that is flexible on route.
The date this appointment is scheduled for.
The beginning of the acceptable time window that the tech may arrive.
The end of the acceptable time window that the tech may arrive.
The classification of the time window for the appointment
The number of minutes this appointment is scheduled for.
The service type ID of this appointment. Reference the endpoint `servicetype` for available options.
The date this appointment was created / added.
The employee ID who created this appointment.
The status code of this appointment.
Friendly representation of status
The number of minutes the tech should call ahead to the customer before arriving.
Whether or not this is the initial appointment for the associated subscription. 1: yes, 0: no
The employee ID of the technician set up as preferred for this service subscription, if this appointment belongs to a one. For stand alone services or reservices it will be -1.
The employee ID who marked this as serviced -- not necessarily which tech completed the service.
The employee ID of the technician who serviced this appointment
The date this appointment was marked as serviced (when the action took place and not necessarily the date of the appointment).
Returns 1 if the customer gave a signature when the appointment was completed, 0 otherwise.
Returns 1 if the tech gave a signature when the appointment was completed, 0 otherwise.
The notes the technician left for the customer.
The notes the technician left ONLY for the office.
The time the technician checked into the appointment (via user defined input).
The time the technician checked out of the appointment (via user-defined input).
The time the technician checked into the appointment (via check-in button).
The time the technician checked out of the appointment (via check-out button).
Miles Per Hour
The direction of the wind -- 8 point compass.
Degrees Farenheight.
The amount the tech reported as being collected.
The method of payment collected. -1: no payment collected, 0: coupon, 1: cash, 2: check, 3: credit card
1: Serviced Interior, 0: Outside only
The ticket / invoice ID associated with the appointment.
Cancelation date
EmployeeIDs of additional techs on the appointment. Comma separated.
Appointment cancellation reason, only returned if parameter 'includeCancellationReason' is included with the request.
Appointment cancellation reason, only returned if parameter 'includeCancellationReason' is included with the request.
Appointment cancellation reason ID.
Appointment reschedule reason ID
Appointment reservice reason ID
An array of unit IDs associated with this appointment (for multi unit customers)

Requires parameter 'includeTargetPests' to be sent with the request. The ID of a target insect associated with the appointment, these IDs can be found in preferences via Admin > Preferences > Service Related > Target Issues
Notes for the appointment.
0 - unspecified, 1 - Exterior only, 2 - Interior Needed
Date the appointment was last changed
EmployeeID that cancelled the appointment.
EmployeeID that was assigned to the appointment.
latIn recorded at appointment completion
latOut recorded at appointment completion
longIn recorded at appointment completion
longOut recorded at appointment completion
When multiple appointments occupy the same spot this determines which of the appointments will be first.
EmployeeID who locked the appointment, or 0 if it is unlocked
appointmentID of original appointment that was rescheduled
productionValue of the appointment if -1 see ticket if that is -1 see serviceType
Due date of the appointment. '0000-00-00' indicates no due date (treat as null).
